observations: Three photos show a large blue plastic drum stacked vertically with a smaller blue drum on top.
The drum has visible scratches, scuffs, and dirt, especially on the lower half.
The top rim of the drum is intact but shows some wear and minor discoloration.
The drum appears to be made of thick plastic, consistent with industrial or chemical storage drums.
No brand or model markings are visible on the drum in any photo.
The seller's text describes it as a 'strong, large cylindrical container made from durable plastic'.

claims.claim: Plastic drum is a strong, large cylindrical container made from durable plastic
